{{Quote|Our antique robo-fountain once stood in Old Doc 8H-QD9's Antivirus Software-Shoppe, a popular hangout for youths out cruising in speeders and engaging in awkward mating rituals. We've restored the device to its original working condition, offering you a chance to experience all the fun and romance of the Republic's golden age with every drink|Dex's Diner menu, on its Robo-Fountain|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Old Doc 8H-QD9's Antivirus Software-Shoppe''' was a popular place for youths to spend their time while cruising in [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and socializing with each other. The shoppe had at least one [[robo-fountain]] that could be used to serve various beverages. A robo-fountain was later acquired, restored, and used by [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Old Doc 8H-QD9's Antivirus Software-Shoppe was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
